tabs.heading: What is Siemens for Startups
tabs.text: Siemens for Startups is a program designed to help early-stage engineering and manufacturing startups accelerate their product development by offering access to Siemens software at reduced cost, along with co-marketing opportunities to amplify their voices.

tabs.heading: Benefits
tabs.text:
Siemens for Startups is designed to empower young companies with the tools, resources, and connections they need to succeed in today's competitive landscape. Benefits include:

  • Faster time to market
  • Improved product development
  • Reduced development costs
  • Enhanced collaboration and innovation

tabs.heading: Programs Supported
tabs.text:
• Hardtech Founders: Designed to help early-stage hardtech companies stretch their dollars further, reduce risks, and amplify their voices to scale faster.
  • Product Designers: Three distinct design and simulation software solution bundles are offered to support design and development, simulation, and product lifecycle management for startups building physical products.
  • QA & Regulatory: The Design Control bundle reduces risk while supporting quality and regulatory success by structuring product requirements, design documents, testing data, risks and external standards into an object-oriented model that startups can use to establish design control with thorough traceability.

tabs.heading: Apply Today!
tabs.text: Ready to support your team with scalable design and simulation engineering solutions? Reach out below to learn more about our startups program and begin your organization's application. Qualified new program members can accelerate their startup journey with up to $5,000 USD in AWS credits.
